title: Detour Notice — CR 31 Culvert Replacement

fields.subject: DETOUR NOTICE — CR 31 culvert replacement
fields.body:
Heads up:

Starting today at 09:00, CR 31 will be closed between 190th Street and 200th Street for a culvert replacement. We expect the closure to last about 3 days, depending on weather and how the new pipe beds in.

The detour is signed via 190th St and State Hwy 9. Local residents can still reach their driveways from both ends of the closure. Through traffic, including loaded trucks, has to take the detour.

The crew foreman on site is Gus Lindahl, cell 320-555-0144. Call him with any questions about access during the work.

Please share this with dispatch and the school bus contractor so they can adjust morning and afternoon routes. The detour map is attached.

Thanks,
fields.signature:
Maintenance Foreman
Calder County Highway Department
Larkin, MN

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. It arrives in the same inbox two minutes after the IP-1 access-road thread. Ops should pass it to dispatch for normal routing and note it on the road status board as a possible future constraint on checkpoint routes. Watch that Ops does not pull Highway staff off the IP-1 access question or confuse CR 31 with the CR 12 and 230th Street access issue.
